demo.title: unitreex.sh
demo.code:
# Make the robot wave hello
bankr prompt "using the unitreex skill, wave hello on my Unitree"

# Check robot state and battery
bankr prompt "using the unitreex skill, check my robot's state"

# Multi-step motion: stand up, balance, walk forward
bankr prompt "using the unitreex skill, tell my robot to come here"

# Shake hands
bankr prompt "using the unitreex skill, shake hands with the G1"

setup: Run the bridge on your robot's LAN: https://github.com/richard7463/unitree-skill (mock mode works with no hardware)
Expose the bridge via cloudflared/ngrok and set `BRIDGE_URL` + `BRIDGE_TOKEN` env vars
Say "wave hello on my Unitree" — the robot moves
